title: Illustration / Duo / Joints
slide_intent: Define how a simple body bends because expressive gestures must remain consistent with its construction.
strategic_value: A repeatable bending method can give Duo emotional range without losing his rounded form.
demonstration: Two rows pair pale construction diagrams with a joyful bent pose and an angry pose.
practical_value: Use added rounded geometry to bend the waist and preserve the underlying body shape.

content_islands.spec: Place the waist, elbow and wrist guidance at right.

reference_purposes.Application: Construction diagrams show waist and wing bending alongside finished expressions.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Duo may bend at waist, elbow and wrists; use a rounded rectangle over the body for a waist bend instead of editing the existing body shape.

ingredient.application: Bend at waist, elbow and wrists as needed; overlay a rounded rectangle for waist bends.
